messages:
Ruth (Design): quick sync 1: Pools bulk-delete UX. two items: required-field signaling (asterisk vs full 'Required') and how to show failures when some rows error in a bulk op. trying to keep the list scannable for power users while accessible for keyboard/AT. Ivy (PM): i'm +1 on one top summary for bulk failures, with links to the rows. users doing bulk ops want a single canonical place to look. Sam (Eng): summary+anchors is easiest to reason about. we should auto-focus the summary after submit and ensure the first Tab goes to the first anchor. Keon (DevEx): also suggest expanding inline details for the first 2 failures by default (collapsed outline) so users get immediate context without leaving the summary. ESC should collapse and return focus. Ruth (Design): for required markers: explicit "Required" vs asterisk for density. pros/cons? a11y-bot: guidance: visible "Required" text is clearer for AT and cognitive load. if you must use asterisk, include a single sr-only legend and ensure the label includes the word "(required)" programmatically. Example:
* = required
. Ivy (PM): proposal: show 'Required' for primary fields (name/owner), use asterisk for lower-priority fields. document this in the component spec. Sam (Eng): noted. back to failures: we should include error categories in the summary (permissions, locked, invalid state) and make each link expand the row details inline. keep DOM stable to avoid layout shift. Keon (DevEx): accessibility pattern: move focus to a container with role="status" and aria-live="polite" announcing the count, e.g.:
3 items failed to delete
. anchors should use aria-controls to reveal the row region. Ruth (Design): typed-confirm for destructive deletes — full typed name vs checkbox + warning. I'd like conditional typed-confirm for high-impact pools. Ivy (PM): agree. conditional rule: typed-confirm when pool is org-owned or >30 members; otherwise checkbox + stronger copy. Sam (Eng): if typed-confirm is enabled: autofocus input, allow paste, set autocomplete="off", disable primary CTA until the trimmed exact match. define case sensitivity (proposal: case-sensitive for max safety). Keon (DevEx): add acceptance criteria: keyboard-only flow (focus lands on modal input, ESC cancels and restores focus), aria-invalid on mismatch and aria-describedby to helper text, and announce match state changes in aria-live. Ruth (Design): microcopy tweak: instead of 'Type the pool name to confirm' -> 'Enter the exact pool name to permanently delete this pool. This action cannot be undone.' a11y-bot: final checklist: 1) summary container with role=status and focus-after-submit, 2) anchors with aria-controls, 3) inline regions with role=region and aria-labelledby, 4) visibleRequired text for key fields, 5) typed-confirm: autofocus, autocomplete=off, aria-invalid on mismatch, aria-describedby for helper text. Ivy (PM): sounds like consensus. Ruth, can you mock the hybrid summary + inline preview and the typed-confirm modal copy? We'll review and finalize the spec. Ruth (Design): will do and tag you all. thanks!
